name: 3-Me-PCP
effects: more stimulating than ketamine per case reports

mechanismOfAction.summary: NMDA receptor antagonist (arylcyclohexylamine class); possible additional NE/DA reuptake inhibition inferred from structural analogues.
mechanismOfAction.description: Piperidine-substituted arylcyclohexylamine; 3-methyl substitution on the phenyl ring (meta). Confirmed NMDA antagonist by class pharmacology. Structurally distinct from 3-MeO-PCP (methoxy vs methyl) — do not transfer doses. First reported to UK forensic services. PCP-family dissociatives carry high psychosis/mania risk, bladder toxicity with chronic use, and dangerous respiratory depression with CNS depressants/opioids.
